name: A Fine Mess
summary: Deep within the irradiated ruins of Gnomeregan, an injured goblin named Kernobee lies battered among troggs after being ambushed by Dark Iron dwarves. Rescuing him uncovers unsettling intelligence about Dark Iron involvement in subterranean drilling machinery, which must be relayed all the way to Booty Bay.

sections.title: A Battered Survivor
sections.body: While navigating the dangerous inner chambers of Gnomeregan, adventurers discover Kernobee stranded in the dormitory area. Severely beaten and groggy, the goblin survived capture by Dark Iron dwarves who left him behind to perish among the feral troggs. Finding a friendly face is his only chance of surviving the trek back through the contaminated corridors.

sections.title: Subterranean Schemes
sections.body: Kernobee holds crucial information regarding dark forces operating beneath Dun Morogh. He reveals that the Dark Iron clan has actively involved itself in constructing a massive super rig. While Kernobee flees across the sea to Ratchet to warn the goblin engineer Tinkerwiz about this brewing threat, he sends his savior south to Booty Bay to deliver word to the goblin engineer Scooty.

faq.answer: Kernobee is a goblin who ventured deep into the ruins of Gnomeregan. He was ambushed, beaten nearly to death by Dark Iron dwarves, and abandoned to the troggs before being rescued.
Kernobee must be safely led through the hostile halls back toward the safety of the Clockwerk Run exit and the upper entrance corridors of the fallen city.

faq.q: Why were the Dark Iron dwarves involved?
faq.answer: The Dark Iron dwarves have been scheming underground, aiding in the design and construction of an enormous super rig drill. Kernobee discovered this plot before the dwarves ambushed him.

faq.q: Where does Kernobee go after escaping?
faq.answer: After reaching safety, Kernobee heads across the sea to Ratchet in the Barrens to warn the tinker Tinkerwiz about the Dark Iron's involvement in the subterranean drilling rig.

faq.q: Why must you report to Scooty in Booty Bay?
faq.answer: Scooty is a goblin engineer stationed in Booty Bay who collaborates with Tinkerwiz and coordinates operations involving high-tech subterranean equipment and transponder networks.

faq.q: How does this relate to Mekgineer Thermaplugg?
faq.answer: Scooty recognizes the ongoing threat posed by Mekgineer Thermaplugg inside Gnomeregan. Helping Kernobee provides aid and supplies to adventurers intending to return and confront the treacherous Mekgineer.

angles.text: Rescuing a trapped brother from Gnomeregan's contaminated depths is a duty of honor, especially against the combined malice of Dark Iron infiltrators and feral troggs.
Uncovering Dark Iron collusion within Dun Morogh's borders confirms that Emperor Thaurissan's agents are actively sabotaging Alliance recovery efforts in Gnomeregan.
The discovery that Dark Iron machinists are constructing a massive super rig raises immediate concerns for any engineer tracking advanced subterranean hardware.
